title: DocumentInventory
description: Parsed document structure (sections + paragraphs + char/line offsets) for the <document> wrapper content. Emitted at Stage 1 by scripts/parse_document.py with empty overrides[]; the LLM may append override entries to correct parser errors without editing the baseline sections/paragraphs. Validated by scripts/validate_artifact.py --kind document_inventory against schema + predicates D1-D4.

schema_version.description: Artifact schema version. Bump on breaking change (mirrors deep-research convention).

frozen_at.description: ISO-8601 instant when Stage 1 finalized the inventory (including LLM overrides).

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of normalized <document> content. Normalization: LF line endings, trailing whitespace stripped per line, NFC unicode. Re-derivable for tamper detection.

parser_version.description: Version of scripts/parse_document.py that produced the baseline. Used to invalidate inventories built with outdated parsers.

overrides.description: LLM corrections to the parser baseline. Empty array when the parser was correct. Apply via document_inventory.resolve_location().

id.description: Stable section ID. Pattern S001, S002, ... assigned sequentially by parser.

level.description: Heading level (1=H1 ... 6=H6). For plaintext without markdown, parser assigns 1 to top-level all-caps headings.

paragraph_ids.description: Ordered list of paragraph IDs belonging to this section. Convenience index — authoritative join is paragraphs[].section_id.

id.description: Stable paragraph ID. Pattern P001, P002, ... assigned sequentially across the entire document.

section_id.description: Authoritative section join. Refers to sections[].id.

ordinal.description: 1-indexed paragraph number WITHIN the parent section. Mirrors Finding.location.paragraph semantics.

path.description: JSON-pointer-like path into sections/paragraphs. Examples: 'sections[2].name', 'paragraphs[5].section_id'. Resolved by validate_artifact.py D3.

before.description: Original value (any JSON). Optional — present for diff readability; not required for override application.

reason.description: Free-text explanation of the correction. Required so future readers understand why the LLM overrode the parser.
